body:
# Lithium — calculated thermodynamic functions

<!-- generated-by: sync-thermochemistry.mjs -->

Source: SRC-000510, NIST Chemistry WebBook / Chase (1998), retrieved 2026-10-06. These are calculations from dated fits, not new measurements. Values below are rounded to four decimal places for computational comparison; this is not a statement of physical precision. Uncertainty: UNKNOWN. Basis: **mol Li**.

[Full calculation and limits](../0003-Lithium-Li-Thermochemistry.md) · [Complete 101-point-per-fit CSV](0003-Lithium-Li-TABLE-010-Thermodynamic-Functions.csv) · [Exact coefficients](../data/structured/0003-Lithium-Li-NIST-Thermochemistry.yaml)

| Fit | Variant | T / K | Cp° / J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ | S° / J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ | H°(T)−H°(298.15 K) / kJ mol⁻¹ |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 1620.1200 | 20.8280 | 173.9643 | 27.4720 |
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 3810.0600 | 23.7100 | 192.3432 | 74.9526 |
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 6000.0000 | 33.5492 | 204.9182 | 136.3994 |

Each row uses only the named phase and fit interval. Do not subtract rows from different phases to obtain transition enthalpy without first resolving their standard-state reference offsets.

sources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook — neutral monatomic Lithium gas thermochemistry (6 October 2026 retrieval)
sources.organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.scope_note: Species-specific gas evaluation; distinct from the retained Lithium isotope, melting/boiling and representative bulk-transport sources. No existing equivalent WebBook gas accession found. Publisher calculations are not independent corroboration.
sources.scope: The exact publisher species is Li with InChI=1S/Li, not Li2, Li ions or an equilibrium vapor mixture. One mole of the source species is one mole of Li atoms. No molecular factor of two applies. The gas-only response supplies one fit for 1620.12–6000 K. A separate retained condensed-phase diagnostic contains two LIQUID fits and one SOLID fit. Those fits are not imported, relabelled, or bound to the neutral atomic GAS state. No gas evaluation below the source minimum 1620.12 K is justified. The retained source limits do not themselves establish a boiling point, a gas stability boundary or a pressure-dependent phase boundary. Existing Li-6/Li-7 records and atomic-weight intervals retain separate scope. No isotope-specific gas properties or numeric isotope abundances are inferred from this elemental fit or its listed molecular weight. The Shomate equations contain no pressure variable. Applied pressure, arbitrary-pressure EOS and phase diagrams are not inferred. Separate source entropy reference-pressure labels belong to those original data only. No Li/Li2 equilibrium fraction, dimer dissociation, ionisation fraction, charge-state mixture or molecular nuclear-spin population is calculated or assigned. Fit boundaries from separate phases and enthalpy reference offsets are retained as reported and are not a constructed phase-transition path or latent-heat calculation. Coefficient uncertainty and covariance are unreported. Printed-temperature cells, output rounding and numerical derivative residuals are source-format/software checks, not physical uncertainty. Independent transcription arithmetic against publisher values and positive samples within the fit do not establish experimental replication, new calorimetry, complete Lithium thermophysics or element completion.
sources.reference: Chase, M.W., Jr. (1998), NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, Fourth Edition. Fit comment: Data last reviewed in June, 1962.
